title: Yellow Smoky Argentinian Shrimp Skewers
description: This diabetic-friendly dish features succulent shrimp marinated in a smoky Argentinian-inspired sauce, grilled to perfection on a cedar plank, and served with a side of melted cheese for a delicious cheese-pull effect.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto the soaked cedar planks, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Place the cedar planks on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the shrimp are pink and cooked through.
While the shrimp are cooking, mix the shredded provolone cheese with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Once the shrimp are cooked, top each skewer with a spoonful of the cheese mixture.
Return the skewers to the grill and cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
